BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RS-3,
Residential Single Unit (Detached House) District symbols and indications as shown on
Map No. 16-G in the area bound by:

the alley next south of and parallel to West 69" Street, South Loomis Street; a line 125

aline 125 feet south and parallel to West 69" Street; the alley next west of and parallel
to South Racine Avenue; West 71*! Street; the alley next south of and parallel to West
71° Street; the alley next east of and parallel to South Ashland Avenue; and the alley
next south of and parallel to West 69" Street,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
